name: light
description: Sonnet. Routine, high-volume subtasks with a clear goal: searching, reading and summarizing files or pages, bulk simple edits, running checks. Use it to keep cost down.

name: advisor
description: Fable. Advice only: architecture, hard trade-offs, tricky debugging analysis, reviewing a plan or a diff. Ask it a question and give it the context; it must not edit files or run commands that change anything. You do the work yourself afterwards.
